But the bridge had one final mystery: sometimes the amounts appeared different to each side—a fog of uncertainty that tested their faith. Some claimed the gods were testing them; others believed it was simply the nature of the chasm itself.

The wise elders taught: "The bridge rewards not perfect calculation, but the courage to trust despite the fog. For abundance flows not from hoarding, but from the risk of giving."

And so the villages learned that prosperity springs from faith in reciprocity.
